name: Subdirectory Hints
description: Lazy AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md context injection during file navigation. When the agent reads a file in a subdirectory, automatically discovers and silently appends AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, or .cursorrules from that directory and its ancestors (up to 5 levels). Deduplicates across a session to avoid repeated injection. Ported from hermes-agent/tools/subdirectory_hints.py.

maxDepth.description: Max ancestor levels to walk when looking for context files (default: 5)

maxContextChars.description: Max characters to inject from a single context file (default: 8000)

fileReadTools.description: Tool names to intercept for subdirectory context discovery (default: read_file, view, cat, read, str_replace_editor)
